correctness.rationale: At the exact rational witness the 6-by-6 quadratic Veronese matrix has rank 4. All first row-replacement determinants vanish. The exact 12-by-12 Hessian has rank 3, with a principal normal 3-by-3 minor -576. Nine explicitly constructed independent tangent vectors to the five-collinear stratum are killed by the Hessian, so they equal its kernel. The cited component has dimension 9; hence the singular locus is smooth at the witness and the normal Hessian is nondegenerate. Holomorphic Morse-Bott gives transverse A1, and openness gives the nonempty generic statement.

value.rationale: The five-collinear locus is a canonical top-dimensional component of the singular rank-drop stratum of the six-point conic determinant. Its exact generic transverse type controls the first local degeneration beyond the smooth locus and is useful as a baseline for the deeper boundary intersections. This is structural local geometry, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of a known table.
